title: Claude Fable 5 builds cinematic 3D websites with AI-generated media #claudeai #fable5 #aibuilders
description: Claude Fable 5 builds cinematic 3D scrolling websites that rival high-end design showcased by brands like Apple. This advanced AI platform integrates Claude Code with Higgsfield MCP to automatically generate images, videos, and complete site structures from a single descriptive prompt. By leveraging the CDANCE 2.0 engine and adjusting reasoning to max levels, Claude Fable 5 transforms simple concepts into award-winning, luxury-grade websites. This technology streamlines web design by automating creative and technical processes, making premium digital presence accessible with unparalleled efficiency. The innovation represents a shift in AI-driven web development, enabling creators and businesses to produce high-quality, visually immersive sites without extensive manual labor or expert skills. #ClaudeFable5 #AIWebDesign #3DWebsites #CDANCE2 #HiggsfieldMCP #LuxuryWebDesign #AIautomation #WebDevelopment #DigitalInnovation #CreativeAI #TechInnovation #ClaudeCode #WebDesignTools #AIinTech #NextGenWebDesign
